strings.**A keyboard-first workflow.** Jump anyw: **A keyboard-first workflow.** Jump anywhere with ⌘K, type to filter any folder, and keep your hands off the mouse if you like.
strings.**Browse and copy files out.** Container: **Browse and copy files out.** Containers appear as folders in the sidebar. Browse their files read-only, fetch contents as needed, or open a terminal inside a container.
strings.**Connect to Server (⌥⌘K)** adds connect: **Connect to Server (⌥⌘K)** adds connections under **Servers** in the sidebar.
strings.**Control Compose stacks.** Start, stop: **Control Compose stacks.** Start, stop or restart a project's containers together, and open the project in your terminal or code editor.
strings.**Familiar file commands** work across e: **Familiar file commands** work across every view, including Quick Look, copying files in and out, renaming and deleting. Moves within a server stay on that server.
strings.**File operations without fear.** Pause: **File operations without fear.** Pause and resume big copies, see conflicts side by side before replacing anything, and undo past operations, even after you quit.
strings.**Folder search.** Press ⌘F to find file: **Folder search.** Press ⌘F to find files in the current folder and its subfolders.
strings.**Folder sizes.** Measure space in the I: **Folder sizes.** Measure space in the Inspector and Disk Usage view.
strings.**Made for people who build things.** Op: **Made for people who build things.** Open folders in Terminal and preview code, data and archives.
strings.**Manage containers in place.** Start, s: **Manage containers in place.** Start, stop, restart or pause them from the context menu or inspector. See their images, ports, mounts and Compose services.
strings.**Previews alongside your files.** Read: **Previews alongside your files.** Read code, Markdown, HTML, JSON, CSV, SQLite databases and archives in the inspector.
strings.**Project tools in the inspector.** Stra: **Project tools in the inspector.** Strata recognizes Node, Rust, Swift, .NET, Python, Go and more. Run project scripts and see how much space build folders such as `node_modules` use.
strings.**S3** supports Amazon S3, Cloudflare R2: **S3** supports Amazon S3, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, Wasabi, MinIO and compatible services. Secret keys stay in your keychain.
strings.**SFTP** uses your SSH setup: `~/.ssh/co: **SFTP** uses your SSH setup: `~/.ssh/config`, keys, the agent and ProxyJump. Open in Terminal starts a shell on the server.

strings.Strata comes in 22 languages and follows: Strata comes in 22 languages and follows your Mac's (or pick one in Settings ▸ General). [Localization/README.md](Localization/README.md) has the four steps.
strings.Strata is open source under the [MIT Lic: Strata is open source under the [MIT License](LICENSE).
strings.Strata runs entirely on your Mac. Search: Strata runs entirely on your Mac. Search, summaries and AI features run locally, with no accounts, tracking or cloud processing. Strata encrypts operation history on disk with a key kept in your Keychain. It connects to the servers you add. Containers' and servers' files are read as you browse and cleared when Strata quits. SFTP logs in with your own SSH setup, and an S3 secret key stays in your keychain.
